schema:
CREATE TABLE Dish (
  description,
  first_appeared,
  highest_price,
  id,
  last_appeared,
  lowest_price,
  menus_appeared,
  name,
  times_appeared
);

CREATE TABLE Menu (
  call_number,
  currency,
  currency_symbol,
  date,
  dish_count,
  event,
  id,
  keywords,
  language,
  location,
  location_type,
  name,
  notes,
  occasion,
  page_count,
  physical_description,
  place,
  sponsor,
  status,
  venue
);

CREATE TABLE MenuItem (
  created_at,
  dish_id,
  high_price,
  id,
  menu_page_id,
  price,
  updated_at,
  xpos,
  ypos
);

CREATE TABLE MenuPage (
  full_height,
  full_width,
  id,
  image_id,
  menu_id,
  page_number,
  uuid
);
